validation_scope: SVG/JSON contract and deliberate negative mutations only: NOT optical proof, structural calculation, 3D clearance, official QA, or ART PASS.

review.method: Original SVG authored studies rendered as PNG and visually inspected, with same diagram layout. Human-scale silhouettes and mass hierarchy reviewed.
review.C1: REJECT: two heavy blank enclosing masses dominate the composition; maker/research remain rectilinear inserts; D10/D11 failure repeats. Daylight is an icon, not a proven quality of place.
review.C2: REJECT: single huge inhabited arch dominates, public functions below are tiny inserted labels/rectangles; D7 motif repeated. Not a distinctive lived district.
review.confidence: These are authorial negative judgments on crude 2D representations; do not infer a physical or 3D certification.
review.outcome: BOTH PRE-3D ART REJECT. No real 3D produced. ART HOLD remains.
